question: What mitigations does ATT&CK list for T1003 (OS Credential Dumping)?

answer.headline: Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
answer.narrative: MITRE ATT&CK lists nine mitigations for T1003 (OS Credential Dumping), including Encrypt Sensitive Information (M1041), Active Directory Configuration (M1015), and Credential Access Protection (M1043).
